about.title: Personal, not anonymous.
about.intro: semanu is an AI-first digital partner from Antwerp. We build 3D configurators and custom business software for SMEs in Europe, from the first sketch to software that runs every day.
about.nameText: semanu comes from the Antwerp dialect, rooted in Flemish. It is an exclamation of admiration, a spontaneous wow when something truly impresses. That is the reaction we aim for. From your customers, when they configure their product in 3D themselves. From your team, when software takes over the repetitive work.
about.missionText: SMEs deserve the same digital strength as large companies, without long projects or big budgets. That is why we develop AI-first: AI speeds up every step from analysis to code, so we deliver 3D configurators and business software faster and more affordably. You start with what adds the most value today and expand step by step. You receive the full source code and can always continue without us.
about.founderText: semanu is led by Tom de Vree and is based in Antwerp. We work personally with SMEs and manufacturers across Europe. You talk directly to the person who builds your solution.

serviceUi.analysisText: Software platforms always start with a thorough business analysis. We map how standardised your flows and processes are and set the expectations and technical criteria upfront. The strength of these projects lies in the preparation.
